text:
elaine: Customer: function hook returned a stringified JSON and validator rejected it as wrong type. Need telemetry + console behavior.
raj: Which hook?
noah: search_v1. Sample: `{"tool_response": "{\"result\": \"ok\"}"}` -> type string vs object.
sanjay: We emit STRUCT_MISMATCH with no coercion info.
amanda: Console should show: reason, attempted_coercion, trace_id, and a safe preview. Default hide raw.
elaine: Proposed telemetry fields: error_reason, attempted_coercion, coercion_strategy, display_hint.
raj: Add dashboard metric validation_rejects_by_reason (labels: hook_id).
noah: Do not store original payload in hot DB. Emit trace_id -> encrypted artifact store.
sanjay: ops-bot: confirm artifact flow?
ops-bot: Confirmed: s3-retain-encrypted, audit-only IAM.
amanda: UX: row with Reject badge, reason, coercion badge, "Open sample" (RBAC gated).
elaine: Short-term: if string parses to expected object, set attempted_coercion=true and accept while incrementing coercion_metric. Surface coerced flag in dashboards.
raj: Agree but flag clearly.
noah: I'll add artifact wiring and ledger tags for billing.
sanjay: I'll add alert: validation_rejects_by_hook >5x baseline in 10m.
amanda: Mockups later today.
ops-bot: Action created #5532123456 RFC+PRs assignees raj,noah,sanjay; due 2026-03-27.
elaine: I'll write RFC and tag owners.
